stem: The incident illustrated by this cartoon increased cynicism toward the U.S. government because —

options.label: A
options.text: the press secretary failed to keep the public informed of national policy changes

options.label: B
options.text: the president directed a conspiracy to mislead the nation

options.label: C
options.text: the Supreme Court overruled federal statutes that defined confidentiality

options.label: D
options.text: Congress failed to pass legislation enforcing protection of privacy rights

visual_elements: A person hanging between two gears holds torn signs that read 'I AM' and 'A CROOK' with a label on their chest reading 'NOT'
